questions.q: What does partitioning mean at the storage level?
options: Splitting a single file into random chunks with no structure
Encrypting data before writing it
The same thing as an in-memory Spark partition
Deliberately organizing files into a directory structure that mirrors a column value, like year/month/day
questions.explain: Storage partitioning is about the directory layout on disk, matching columns you filter on often.

questions.q: What is the Hive-style partitioning convention?
options: A naming convention exclusive to Apache Hive with no other tool support
A convention only used for CSV files
Directory names in the form key=value, like year=2024/month=01/
Storing all partitions in a single flat file
questions.explain: This key=value directory naming is widely recognized by Spark, Databricks, Synapse, and most big-data tools.

options: A method for compressing partition directory names
Deleting old partitions automatically after a fixed time period
The same thing as column pruning within a single file
Skipping entire directories of files that a query's filter can't possibly match, without opening any of them
questions.explain: Partition pruning operates one level above column pruning — it skips whole files and directories, not just parts of one file.

questions.q: How does a 'Spark partition' (Lesson 33) differ from the storage partitioning covered in this lesson?
options: Spark partitions only apply to CSV files, never Parquet
They are exactly the same concept with no difference at all
Storage partitioning only exists inside Spark, not on disk
A Spark partition is a unit of in-memory parallelism while processing data, not a directory structure on disk
questions.explain: Same word, two different layers of the stack — this lesson covers the on-disk directory kind.

questions.q: Why is partitioning on a column with millions of distinct values usually a mistake?
options: Azure physically forbids more than 100 partition directories
It creates millions of tiny directories instead of a few useful, prunable ones — a problem called over-partitioning
It only affects CSV files, not Parquet
It has no downside and is always the best choice
questions.explain: Good partition columns have a manageable number of distinct values, like year/month/day, not something like a raw timestamp.
